### 🚀 v1.1.0 Release Notes — 📊 Google Trends Historical Scraper & Python Data Science Suite (2004–Present, Bulk 100+ Keywords, `$0.30 / 1K`)

Longitudinal Google Trends Historical Scraper (2004–present) and Python Data Science SDK Suite on Apify (`$0.30–$0.45 / 1,000 results`). Extract bulk 100+ keyword interest time series, DMA/metro/city sub-region breakdowns, breakout topics, YouTube search trends, and Google Shopping demand to JSON, CSV, Pandas, or n8n.

- 📓 **1-Click Interactive Google Colab Notebook:** [**Open `notebooks/quickstart.ipynb` in Colab**](https://colab.research.google.com/github/unitbytes/google_trends_scraper/blob/main/notebooks/quickstart.ipynb)
- 🤖 **AI Coding Agent MCP Ready:** Includes `.cursor/mcp.json` for Cursor, Windsurf, and Claude Code.
- 🔧 **9-Node n8n Automation Workflows:** Ready-to-import `.json` templates under `n8n/` and at **[unitbytes.com/n8n](https://unitbytes.com/n8n/)**.
